paragraphs: Ingersoll Rand Inc. is a diversified, global provider of mission-critical flow creation products, and industrial and life science solutions. The accompanying consolidated financial statements include the accounts of Ingersoll Rand Inc. and its majority-owned subsidiaries (collectively referred to herein as "Ingersoll Rand," "Company," "we," "us," "our," or "ourselves").

We are a global market leader with a broad flow creation and industrial product portfolio across air, gas, powder, and liquid handling applications, providing services and solutions to increase industrial and life science productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. We manufacture one of the broadest and most complete ranges of compressor, pump, vacuum and blower products in our markets, which, when combined with our global geographic footprint and application expertise, allows us to provide differentiated product and service offerings to our customers. Our products are sold under more than 90 market-leading brands, including Ingersoll Rand and Gardner Denver, which we believe are globally recognized in their respective end-markets and known for product quality, reliability, efficiency and superior customer service. We are driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset, dedicated to helping make life better for our employees, customers, the planet, and our shareholders.

These attributes, along with over 165 years of engineering heritage, generate strong brand loyalty for our products and foster long-standing customer relationships, resulting in leading market positions within each of our operating segments. We have sales in all major geographic markets and our diverse customer base utilizes our products across a wide array of end-markets, including life sciences, food and beverage production, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, water and wastewater treatment, and many others.

Our products and services are critical to the processes and systems in which they are utilized, which are often complex and for which the cost of failure or downtime is high. However, our products typically represent only a small portion of the costs of the overall systems or functions that they support. As a result, our customers place a high value on our application expertise, product reliability, and the responsiveness of our service. To support our customers and market presence, we maintain significant global scale with over 60 key manufacturing facilities, and over 50 complementary service and repair centers across six continents and over 21,000 employees worldwide as of December 31, 2025.

The process-critical nature of our product applications, coupled with the standard wear and tear replacement cycles associated with the usage of our products, generates opportunities to support customers with our broad portfolio of services, spare parts, and consumables. Customers place a high value on maximizing the time their operations are online, reducing their operating expenses, and improving the sustainability of their processes. As a result, the availability of replacement parts, consumables and our repair and support services are key components of our value proposition. Our large installed base of products provides a
recurring revenue stream through our aftermarket parts, consumables and services offerings. As a result, our aftermarket revenue is significant, representing 36.5% of total Company revenue in 2025.

We design, manufacture, market and service a broad range of air and gas compression and treatment equipment, vacuum and blower products, fluid transfer equipment, loading systems, power tools and lifting equipment, and other specialized equipment including associated aftermarket parts, consumables and services. We primarily sell under the Ingersoll Rand, Gardner Denver, Nash, CompAir, Elmo Rietschle, and over 35 other brands. Our customers deploy our products across a wide array of applications in diverse end-markets. Compressors are used to increase the pressure of air or gas, vacuum products are used to remove air or gas in order to reduce the pressure below atmospheric levels, and blower products are used to produce a high volume of air or gas at low pressure. Almost every manufacturing and industrial facility, and many service and process industry applications, use air compression, vacuum and blower products in a variety of process-critical applications such as the operation of pneumatic tools, pumps and motion control components, air and gas separation, vacuum packaging of food products and aeration of waste water, among others. Our vacuum pumps and compressors are used in many power generation, mining, oil and gas refining and processing, chemical processing and general industrial applications including flare gas and vapor recovery, geothermal gas removal, vacuum deaeration, water extraction in mining and paper, and chlorine compression in petrochemical operations. Our engineered loading systems and fluid transfer equipment ensure the safe handling and transfer of crude oil, liquefied natural gas, compressed natural gas, chemicals, and bulk materials. Our power tools and lifting equipment portfolio includes electric and cordless fastening systems, pneumatic bolting tools, drilling and material removal tools, hoists, winches and ergonomic handling devices. Typical applications for these products include the precision fastening of bolted joints in the production, assembly and servicing of industrial machinery, on-highway and off-highway vehicles, aircraft, electronics and other equipment.

Our compression products cover the full range of technologies, including rotary screw, reciprocating piston, scroll, rotary vane and centrifugal compressors. Our vacuum products and blowers also cover the full technology spectrum; vacuum technologies include side channel, liquid ring, claw vacuum, screw, turbo and rotary vane vacuum pumps among others, while blower technologies include rotary lobe, screw, claw and vane, side channel and radial blowers.

We complement these products with a broad portfolio of service options tailored to customer needs and a complete range of aftermarket parts, air treatment equipment, controls and other accessories delivered through our global network of manufacturing and service locations and distributor partners. The breadth and depth of our product offering creates incremental business opportunities by allowing us to cross-sell our full product portfolio and uniquely address customers' needs in one complete solution.

We sell our products through an integrated network of direct sales representatives and independent distributors, which is tailored to meet the dynamics of each target geography or end-market. Our large installed base also provides for a significant stream of recurring aftermarket revenue. For example, the useful life of a compressor is, on average, between 10 and 12 years, and requires service at regular intervals, beginning at the time of installation and continuing throughout the life of the product. The cumulative aftermarket revenue generated by a compressor over the product's life cycle will typically exceed its original sale price.

We design, manufacture and market a broad range of highly-specialized equipment for both industrial and life sciences markets. Our products are used for precision dosing, liquid and solid transfer, dispensing, gas compression, gas sampling, pressure management, flow control, and powder handling, amongst other applications. Major categories of our portfolio are (a) pumps and liquid handling systems and (b) life science tools and systems. Within pumps and liquid handling systems, our offering covers a broad range of pump and flow control technology types. This includes diaphragm pumps, piston pumps, water-powered pumps, peristaltic pumps, gear pumps, vane pumps, progressive cavity pumps, syringe pumps, gas boosters, hydrogen compression systems, automated liquid handling systems, odorant injection systems, controls, software and other related components and accessories. These offerings are sold under brands that are highly recognized in their end markets including Air Dimensions, Albin, ARO, Dosatron, Haskel, Ingersoll Rand, LMI, Maximus, Milton Roy, MP, Oberdorfer, Seepex, Thomas, Welch, Williams, YZ and Zinsser Analytic. Within life science tools and systems, our primary offerings include single-use powder and liquid handling systems and isolators for disposable process and containment applications, and contract design and productions for services for silicone, thermoplastic, and specialty components and assemblies for medical devices. These offerings are sold primarily under the ILC Dover and Flexan brands. We also manufacture space suits, inflatable habitats, and lighter-than-air vehicles for human mobility and habitation and defense applications. Our customer base is composed of a

wide range of end users in markets including life sciences, industrial manufacturing, water and waste water, chemical processing, energy, food and beverage, agriculture and others. Our sales are realized primarily through a combination of independent specialty and national distributors and relationships directly with original equipment manufacturers ("OEM"), Engineering, Procurement and Construction ("EPC") companies and end users.

The Company continued its focus on generating inorganic growth through acquisitions that strengthen our position in core product categories and broaden our exposure to high-growth, sustainable end markets. We completed or announced the acquisition of several businesses during 2025, including the following:

•In February 2025, the Company completed the acquisition of SSI Aeration, Inc. ("SSI") for cash consideration of $97.8 million. The business is a manufacturer of wastewater treatment plant equipment. The acquisition will enable Ingersoll Rand to combine several technologies like low pressure compressors with SSI's aeration offerings to provide a comprehensive, end-to-end solution.

headings: We have exposure to the risks associated with instability in the global economy, financial markets and our end markets, which may negatively impact our revenues, liquidity, suppliers and customers.
More than half of our sales and operations are in non-U.S. jurisdictions and we are subject to the economic, political, regulatory and other risks of international operations.
Information systems failure or disruption, due to cyber terrorism or other actions, may adversely impact our business and result in financial loss to the Company or liability to our customers.
Acquisitions, including integrating such acquisitions, and dispositions create certain risks and may affect our operating results.
We face competition in the markets we serve, which could materially and adversely affect our operating results.
The nature of our products creates the possibility of significant product liability, warranty claims, and product recalls, which could harm our business.
Changes in U.S. tariff policy or reciprocal tariffs by foreign governments, remain uncertain and could impact our financial results.
Our results of operations are subject to exchange rate and other currency risks. A significant movement in exchange rates could adversely impact our results of operations and cash flows.
If we are unable to develop new products and technologies, our competitive position may be impaired, which could materially and adversely affect our sales and market share.
A natural disaster, catastrophe, pandemic, or other event could adversely affect our operations.
Uncertainties with respect to the development, and use of artificial intelligence in our business and products may result in harm to our business and reputation.
Our business could suffer if we experience employee work stoppages, union and work council campaigns or other labor difficulties.
Our success depends on our ability to attract, retain and develop key personnel and other talent throughout the Company.

The risk of non-compliance with U.S. and foreign laws and regulations applicable to our international operations could have a significant impact on our results of operations, financial condition or strategic objectives.
Cost overruns, delays, penalties or liquidated damages could negatively impact our results, particularly with respect to fixed-price contracts for custom engineered products.
The loss of, or disruption in, our distribution network could have a negative impact on our abilities to ship products, meet customer demand and otherwise operate our business.
A significant portion of our assets consists of goodwill and other intangible assets, the value of which may be reduced if we determine that those assets are impaired.
Shareholder, customer and regulatory agency emphasis on environmental, social, and governance responsibility may impose additional costs on us or expose us to new risks.
Our operating results could be adversely affected by a loss or reduction of business with key customers or consolidation or the vertical integration of our customer base.
Credit and counterparty risks could harm our business.
Environmental compliance costs and liabilities could adversely affect our financial condition.
We face risks associated with our pension and other postretirement benefit obligations.
Our indebtedness could have important adverse consequences and adversely affect our financial condition.

We may not be able to generate sufficient cash to service all of our indebtedness and may be forced to take other actions to satisfy our obligations under our indebtedness, which may not be successful.
Our fixed rate to floating rate swap contracts subject us to risks related to interest rate risk, counterparty credit worthiness and non-performance on these instruments.
paragraphs: The following risk factors as well as the other information included in this Form 10-K, including "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" and our consolidated financial statements and related notes thereto should be carefully considered. Any of the following risks could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition or results of operations. The selected risks described below, however, are not the only risks facing us. Additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or those we currently view to be immaterial may also materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition or results of operations.

Our financial performance depends, in large part, on conditions in the markets we serve and on the general condition of the global economy, which impacts these markets. Any sustained weakness in demand for our products and services resulting from a contraction or uncertainty in the global economy could adversely impact our revenues and profitability.

In addition, we believe that many of our suppliers and customers access global credit markets to provide liquidity, and in some cases, utilize external financing to purchase products or finance operations. If our customers are unable to access credit markets or lack liquidity, customer demand for our products and services may be impacted.

Furthermore, our products are sold in many industries, some of which are cyclical and may experience periodic contractions. Cyclical weakness in the industries that we serve could adversely affect demand for our products and affect our profitability and financial performance.

For the year ended December 31, 2025, 58% of our revenues were from customers in countries outside of the United States. We have manufacturing facilities in Germany, the United Kingdom, China, Italy, India and other countries. We intend to continue to expand our international operations to the extent that suitable opportunities become available. Non-U.S. operations and United States export sales could be adversely affected as a result of: political or economic instability in certain countries; differences in foreign laws, including increased difficulties in protecting intellectual property and uncertainty in enforcement of contract rights; credit risks; currency fluctuations, in particular, changes in currency exchange rates between the U.S. dollar, Euro, British Pound and the Chinese Renminbi; exchange controls; changes in and uncertainties with respect to tariffs and import/export trade restrictions, as well as other changes in political policy in the United States, China, the U.K. and certain European countries (including the impacts of the U.K.'s withdrawal from the European Union); royalty and tax increases; nationalization of private enterprises, especially in China where we have material operations, supply chain dependencies and hold material cash balances; civil unrest and protests, strikes, acts of terrorism, war or other armed conflict (including the
Russia-Ukraine war and conflicts in the Middle East); shipping products during times of crisis or war; and other factors inherent in foreign operations.

paragraphs: Ingersoll Rand Inc. 為一間多元化、全球性的公司，提供關鍵任務的流體產生產品，以及工業與生命科學解決方案。附表之合併財務報表包含 Ingersoll Rand Inc. 及其過半數擁有之子公司（以下統稱為 "Ingersoll Rand," "Company," "we," "us," "our," 或 "ourselves"）之帳戶。

我們為全球市場領導者，擁有廣泛的流體產生與工業產品組合，應用於空氣、氣體、粉末與液體處理領域，提供服務與解決方案以提高工業與生命科學的生產力、效率與永續性。我們製造的壓縮機、泵、真空與風機產品種類齊全，為市場上最廣且最完整的產品線，結合我們全球的地理佈局與應用專業知識，使我們能為客戶提供差異化的產品與服務。我們的產品在超過 90 個市場領導品牌下銷售，包括 Ingersoll Rand 與 Gardner Denver，我們認為這些品牌在各自終端市場中為 globally recognized，且以產品品質、可靠性、效率與優越的客戶服務聞名。我們以創業精神與擁有者思維為驅動，致力於幫助員工、客戶、地球與股東創造更好的生活。
這些特質，加上超過 165 年的工程傳統，為我們的產品建立強大的品牌忠誠度，並培養長期的客戶關係，使我們在每個運營分部中均處於市場領先地位。我們在所有主要地理市場均有銷售，而我們多樣化的客戶羣體在多種終端市場中使用我們的產品，包括生命科學、食品與飲料生產、潔淨能源、工業製造、基礎建設、水與廢水處理，以及其他許多領域。

我們的產品與服務對其應用的流程與系統至關重要，這些流程與系統往往複雜，且失敗或停機的代價很高。然而，我們的產品通常僅佔其所支持的整體系統或功能成本的一小部分。因此，客戶非常重視我們的應用專業知識、產品可靠性與服務的回應速度。為支持客戶與市場存在，我們維持著重要的全球規模，擁有超過 60 個關鍵製造廠，以及在六大洲超過 50 個補充性服務與維修中心，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，全球員工數逾 21,000 人。
我們產品應用的流程關鍵性，加上產品使用所伴隨的標準磨損與更換週期，為我們提供支持客戶的機會，透過我們廣泛的服務、備用零件與消耗品組合。客戶非常重視最大化其運作時間、降低營運費用，並改善其流程的永續性。因此，備用零件、消耗品與我們的維修與支援服務的可取得性，是我們價值主張的關鍵組成部分。我們龐大的產品安裝基礎提供了
透過我們的後市場零件、消耗品與服務組合，產生持續的收入流。因此，我們的後市場收入相當重要，佔 2025 年總公司營業收入的 36.5%。

我們設計、製造、行銷與服務一系列的空氣與氣體壓縮與處理設備、真空與風機產品、流體傳輸設備、裝載系統、電動工具與起重設備，以及其他專門設備，包括相關的後市場零件、消耗品與服務。我們主要以 Ingersoll Rand、Gardner Denver、Nash、CompAir、Elmo Rietschle 與超過 35 個其他品牌銷售產品。我們的客戶在多種終端市場中部署我們的產品。壓縮機用於增加空氣或氣體的壓力，真空產品用於去除空氣或氣體以降低壓力至大氣層以下，風機產品用於產生大量空氣或氣體在低壓力下。幾乎每間製造與工業設施，以及許多服務與流程產業應用，均在多種流程關鍵應用中使用空氣壓縮、真空與風機產品，例如氣動工具、泵與運動控制元件的運作、空氣與氣體分離、食品產品的真空包裝與廢水曝氣，等等。我們的真空泵與壓縮機用於許多電力發電、採礦、石油與天然氣精煉與處理、化學處理與一般工業應用，包括氣體回收、地熱氣體去除、真空脫氣、礦業與紙業的水提取，以及石化操作中的氯氣壓縮。我們的工程裝載系統與流體傳輸設備確保原油、液化天然氣、壓縮天然氣、化學品與大宗物料的安全處理與轉運。我們的電動工具與起重設備組合包括電動與無線快裝系統、氣動螺栓工具、鑽孔與材料去除工具、起重機、牽引機與人體工學處理裝置。這些產品的典型應用包括在工業機械的生產、組裝與維護中，高爾夫車與非高爾夫車、飛機、電子產品及其他設備的精確螺栓連接。
我們的壓縮產品涵蓋完整的技術範疇，包括旋轉螺桿、往復式活塞、渦旋、旋轉槳片與離心式壓縮機。我們的真空產品與風機也涵蓋完整的技術範疇；真空技術包括側通道、液環、爪式真空、螺桿、渦輪與旋轉槳片真空泵等，而風機技術包括旋轉葉片、螺桿、爪式與槳片、側通道與徑向風機。
我們以廣泛的服務選項搭配這些產品，這些服務選項是根據客戶需求量身打造，並透過我們全球的製造與服務據點及經銷商夥伴，提供完整的後市場零組件、空氣處理設備、控制系統及其他配件。我們產品的廣度與深度創造了增量商機，使我們能跨銷售完整的產品組合，並以單一完整解決方案獨特地滿足客戶需求。
我們透過整合的直接銷售代表與獨立經銷商網路銷售產品，此網路根據各目標地理區域或最終市場的特性進行調整。我們龐大的已安裝基礎也帶來了顯著的後市場收入流。例如，壓縮機的使用壽命平均為10至12年，並需要定期維護，從安裝開始持續至產品壽命結束。壓縮機在其產品生命週期內產生的總後市場收入，通常會超過其原始銷售價格。

我們設計、製造並行銷廣泛的高專業化設備，應用於工業與生命科學市場。我們的產品用於精確計量、液體與固體轉移、灌裝、氣體壓縮、氣體取樣、壓力管理、流量控制及粉末處理等應用。我們產品組合的主要類別為(a)泵與液體處理系統，以及(b)生命科學工具與系統。在泵與液體處理系統方面，我們的產品涵蓋廣泛的泵與流量控制技術類型。這包括隔膜泵、活塞泵、水動泵、蠕動泵、齒輪泵、葉片泵、漸開腔泵、注射器泵、氣體增壓器、氫氣壓縮系統、自動化液體處理系統、氣味注入系統、控制系統、軟體及其他相關零組件與配件。這些產品在終端市場中以高度知名的品牌銷售，包括Air Dimensions、Albin、ARO、Dosatron、Haskel、Ingersoll Rand、LMI、Maximus、Milton Roy、MP、Oberdorfer、Seepex、Thomas、Welch、Williams、YZ及Zinsser Analytic。在生命科學工具與系統方面，我們的主要產品包括一次性粉末與液體處理系統及隔離器，用於一次性流程與封裝應用，以及為醫療器材提供矽膠、熱塑性及特殊零組件與組裝的合同設計與製造服務。這些產品主要以ILC Dover與Flexan品牌銷售。我們也製造太空服、可充氣居所及輕於空氣的飛行器，用於人體移動與居住及防禦應用。我們的客戶羣體由來自生命科學、工業製造、水與廢水處理、化學加工、能源、食品與飲料、農業等市場的廣泛終端用戶組成。
我們的銷售主要透過獨立專業與全國性經銷商的組合，以及與原始設備製造商（"OEM"）、工程、採購與建設（"EPC"）公司及終端用戶的直接關係實現。
本公司持續著力於透過收購產生無機增長，以強化我們在核心產品類別的優勢，並擴大我們在高成長、可持續終端市場的曝光度。我們在2025年完成了或宣佈了幾項收購，包括以下內容：
•2025年2月，本公司以現金9780萬美元完成收購SSI Aeration, Inc.（"SSI"）。該公司是一家廢水處理廠設備製造商。此次收購將使Ingersoll Rand能將低壓壓縮機等技術與SSI的曝氣產品結合，提供完整的端到端解決方案。

paragraphs: Ingersoll Rand 為全球市場領導者，擁有廣泛的創新且攸關關鍵的空氣、流體、潔淨能源與醫療科技，提供服務與解決方案以提升工業生產力與效率。我們製造的壓縮機、泵、真空與風機產品，為市場上最廣泛且最完整的產品線之一，結合我們的全球地理佈局與應用專業知識，使我們能為客戶提供差異化的產品與服務。我們的產品銷售於一系列首屈一指、市場領先的品牌，包括 Ingersoll Rand、Gardner Denver、Nash、CompAir、Thomas、Milton Roy、Seepex、Elmo Rietschle、ARO、Robuschi、ILC Dover、Emco Wheaton 和 Runtech Systems，我們相信這些品牌在各自終端市場中為 globally recognized，並以產品品質、可靠性、效率與優越的客戶服務聞名。
這些特質，加上超過 165 年的工程傳統，為我們的產品建立了強大的品牌忠誠度，並促成了長期的客戶關係，我們相信這已使我們在每個運營分部中取得領先的市場地位。我們在所有主要地理市場均有銷售，而我們多樣化的客戶羣體則在廣泛的終端市場中使用我們的產品，這些市場具有有利的短期與長期成長潛力，包括工業製造、潔淨能源、運輸、醫療與實驗室科學、食品與飲料包裝以及化學製造。

我們的產品與服務對其應用的流程與系統至關重要，這些流程與系統往往複雜且在惡劣條件下運作，失敗或停機的成本很高。然而，我們的產品與服務通常僅佔其所支持的整體系統或功能成本的一小部分。因此，客戶非常重視我們的應用專業知識、產品可靠性以及我們服務的回應速度。為支持客戶與市場地位，我們維持著重要的全球規模，擁有超過 60 個關鍵製造廠，以及在六大洲超過 50 個補充性服務與維修中心，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，全球員工數超過 21,000 人。

我們產品應用的流程至關重要，加上產品使用所伴隨的標準磨損與更換週期，為我們提供支持客戶的廣泛後市場零組件、消耗品與服務機會。客戶非常重視減少其運作中斷的時間。因此，後市場零組件、消耗品以及我們的維修與支援服務的可取得性，為我們價值主張的關鍵組成部分。我們龐大的已安裝產品基礎，透過後市場零組件、消耗品與服務的提供，產生持續的收入流。因此，我們的後市場收入相當顯著，佔 2025 年本公司總營業收入的 36.5%。

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
我們面臨全球經濟、金融市場及終端市場不穩定的風險，這可能會對我們的營業收入、流動性、供應商及客戶產生負面影響。
我們超過一半的銷售與營運活動發生在非美國司法管轄區域，我們面臨國際營運所涉及的經濟、政治、法規及其他風險。
資訊系統的故障或中斷，因網路恐怖攻擊或其他行為，可能會對我們的業務產生負面影響，並導致本公司產生財務損失或對客戶產生責任。
收購（包括整合這些收購）及處分會產生某些風險，並可能影響我們的營運結果。
我們在服務的市場面臨競爭，這可能會對我們的營運結果產生重大且負面的影響。
我們產品的性質會導致產生重大產品責任、保固聲請及產品回收的可能，這可能會對我們的業務造成損害。
美國關稅政策的變動或外國政府的反制關稅政策仍不確定，可能會影響我們的財務結果。
本公司營運成果受匯率及其他貨幣風險影響。匯率大幅波動可能對本公司營運成果及現金流造成不利影響。
若本公司無法開發新產品與技術，將可能影響本公司競爭地位，進而對銷售額與市佔率造成重大且不利的影響。
自然災害、災難、疫情或其他事件可能對本公司營運造成不利影響。
本公司在業務與產品中對人工智慧之發展與應用所產生之不確定性，可能對本公司業務與聲譽造成損害。
若本公司遭遇員工罷工、工會與工作委員會運動或其他勞動問題，將可能影響本公司營運。
本公司之成功取決於本公司吸引、留住並培養關鍵人才及其他人才之能力。
本公司未遵守美國及外國法律與法規，可能對本公司營運成果、財務狀況或戰略目標造成重大影響。
成本超支、延誤、處罰或賠償金等，可能對本公司營運成果造成負面影響，特別是在訂有固定價格合約之客製化工程產品方面。
本公司分銷網路之喪失或中斷，可能對本公司發貨產品、滿足客戶需求及執行營運業務之能力造成負面影響。
本公司資產之重大部分為商譽及其他無形資產，若本公司判定這些資產已減損，其價值可能降低。
股東、客戶及監管機構對環境、社會及治理責任之重視，可能對本公司造成額外成本或使本公司面臨新風險。
本公司營運成果可能因與關鍵客戶之業務流失或減少，或客戶基礎之併購或垂直整合而受到負面影響。
信貸及交易對方風險可能對本公司業務造成損害。
環境合規成本及責任可能對本公司財務狀況造成負面影響。
本公司面臨與退休金及其他退休後福利義務相關之風險。
與本公司負債相關之風險
本公司負債可能產生重要不利後果，並對本公司財務狀況造成不利影響。
本公司可能無法產生足夠現金以償付所有負債，並可能被迫採取其他行動以履行本公司負債之義務，而此等行動可能無法成功。
本公司固定利率與浮動利率掉期合約使本公司面臨與利率風險、交易對手信用worthiness及這些工具之履約風險相關之風險。
paragraphs: 下列風險因素以及本 Form 10-K 所包含的其他資訊，包括「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之分析」及我們的合併財務報表及其相關附註，應謹慎考量。任何下列風險因素都可能對我們的業務、財務狀況或營運成果造成重大且不利的影響。然而，下列所選取的風險因素並非我們所面臨的唯一風險。尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前我們尚未知悉，或目前認為不重要，也可能對我們的業務、財務狀況或營運成果造成重大且不利的影響。
我們的財務表現在很大程度上取決於我們所服務市場的狀況以及全球總體經濟的整體情況，而這些市場會受到總體經濟的影響。如果因全球經濟收縮或不確定性而導致對我們產品與服務的需求持續疲軟，可能會對我們的營業收入與獲利能力造成不利影響。
此外，我們認為許多我們的供應商與客戶會透過全球信貸市場來提供流動性，並在某些情況下，利用外部融資來購買產品或資助營運。如果我們的客戶無法取得信貸市場或缺乏流動性，可能會影響客戶對我們產品與服務的需求。
此外，我們的產品銷售於許多產業，其中一些產業具有週期性，可能會經歷週期性的收縮。我們所服務產業的週期性疲軟可能會對我們產品的需求造成不利影響，並影響我們的獲利能力與財務表現。

截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們 58% 的營業收入來自美國以外國家的客戶。我們在德國、英國、中國、義大利、印度及其他國家設有製造設施。我們有意在適當的機會出現時，持續擴展我們的國際業務。非美國業務與美國出口銷售可能會因以下因素而受到不利影響：某些國家的政治或經濟不穩定；外國法律的差異，包括保護智慧財產權的困難度增加以及契約權利執行的不確定性；信貸風險；貨幣波動，特別是美元、歐元、英鎊與中國人民幣之間的匯率變動；外匯管制；關稅與進出口貿易限制的變化與不確定性，以及美國、中國、英國與某些歐洲國家（包括英國退出歐盟的影響）的其他政治政策變動；版稅與稅收的增加；私營企業的國有化，特別是在中國，我們有重大業務、供應鏈依存度與持有重大現金餘額；民間動亂與示威、罷工、恐怖攻擊、戰爭或其它武裝衝突（包括俄羅斯與烏克蘭戰爭以及中東地區的衝突）；在危機或戰爭期間運送產品；以及其它與外國業務固有的因素。
